links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT responses to ophthalmology patient questions
links.effect: Mean FRE 45.3 ± 9.98 and FKGL 10.1 ± 1.74, i.e., above the typical patient reading level.
links.quote: Readability scores resulted in a mean FRE of 45.3 ± 9.98 and FKGL of 10.1 ± 1.74.

links.outcome: Urgency-to-seek-care recommendations in ChatGPT responses to ophthalmology symptom questions
links.effect: Urgency scores averaged 2.45 ± 0.60, with only the narrow-angle glaucoma response prompting an ambulance call.
links.quote: Urgency to seek care scores averaged 2.45 ± 0.60, with only the narrow-angle glaucoma response prompting an ambulance call.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability on common ophthalmology patient questions using expert review and readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
